postings.title: Join Our Talent Network – Future Opportunities: Design
postings.description:
UX DESIGNER/RESEARCHER – FUTURE OPPORTUNITIES

Focus Digital is always looking for talented UX Designers and Researchers to join our team. While we may not have an open role at this time, we encourage you to submit your resume for future consideration. By joining our talent network, you’ll be among the first to hear about new opportunities that align with your skills and interests.




ABOUT FOCUS

Focus https://focusconsulting.io/ is a  digital services firm dedicated to delivering on projects with impact in the civic tech space. We transform outdated government systems into modern, efficient solutions that deliver better outcomes for citizens.

Our design team partners with federal and state agencies to modernize systems and improve user experiences. We’ve worked with agencies such as the IRS and Grants.gov http://Grants.gov to streamline workflows and enhance accessibility. As a growing team, we’re always looking for talented professionals who want to help shape the future of government digital services.

At Focus Digital, we believe in doing impactful work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We encourage our team to log off at the end of the day, take time off when needed, and bring their best selves to work.

We are a fully remote company, and all employees must be based in the continental U.S. Some projects may require occasional travel, approximately 1-2 times per year.




WHAT DESIGNERS DO AT FOCUS

• Collaborate with product and technology teams to improve digital user experiences

• Advocate for users while balancing business and technical constraints

• Conduct and synthesize user research to inform product and design decisions

• Support service design efforts to visualize systems and improve workflows

• Create wireframes and prototypes using established design systems

• Deliver UX, UI, and interaction designs ready for implementation

• Work transparently by sharing ideas and designs early and often



If you’re interested in future opportunities at Focus Digital, we’d love to hear from you! Submit your resume to stay connected with us as new roles open.

postings.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (DevOps)
postings.description:
ABOUT FOCUS 

Focus https://focusconsulting.io/ is a digital services firm dedicated to delivering on projects with impact in the civic tech space. We partner with states and federal agencies—including the Department of State, IRS, and the Department of Education—transform outdated systems into modern, efficient solutions that deliver better outcomes for citizens.

At Focus, we believe in doing impactful work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. We encourage our team to log off at the end of the day, take time off when needed, and bring their best selves to work. We are intentional about staying on the cutting edge of our tooling and practices—from modern cloud development environments to integrating AI into our daily workflows—so our engineers spend their time solving hard problems, not fighting dull tools.

We are a fully remote company, and all employees must be based in the continental U.S. Some projects may require occasional travel, approximately 1-2 times per year.

 


ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, deployability, and observability of complex, multi-vendor government platforms running in secure environments. You will build and maintain infrastructure as code in Terraform, design CI/CD pipelines, establish monitoring practices, and recommend SLOs to define and support system health. You’ll work closely with product teams, client stakeholders, and partner organizations, bringing SRE and DevOps practices to environments that are often in the middle of modernization.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure using Terraform, including reusable modules and patterns that other teams can adopt.

 - Build and improve CI/CD pipelines that support frequent, low-risk releases, with automated testing, security scanning, and promotion across environments.

 - Define and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services, and use them to guide reliability priorities and release decisions.

 - Implement observability through metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and actionable alerts.

 - Lead incident response and blameless postmortems, and drive follow-up work to completion. Participate in an on-call rotation as needed by the engagement.

 - Troubleshoot complex, distributed systems across infrastructure, application, and network layers.

 - Embed security and compliance into infrastructure and delivery, including vulnerability management, patching, secrets management, and support for ATO and continuous monitoring processes.

 - Automate operational toil with scripts and tooling in languages such as Python, Go, or TypeScript.

 - Serve as a technical advisor to client stakeholders, translating reliability and infrastructure tradeoffs into clear recommendations.

 - Mentor teammates through code and infrastructure reviews, pairing, and documented runbooks and standards.

 


SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of professional experience in SRE, DevOps, platform, or cloud infrastructure engineering.

 - Significant hands-on experience with Terraform in production, including module design, state management, and running plan/apply workflows through CI.

 - Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).

 - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Go, or TypeScript.

 - Experience with observability tools (e.g., DataDog, CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus) and with designing meaningful alerts.

 - Experience with containers and container orchestration (e.g., Docker, ECS, Kubernetes).

 - Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, or ATO processes.

 - Experience supporting legacy modernization or cloud migration efforts.

 - Familiarity with AWS GovCloud environments, FedRAMP compliance standards, and observability tooling such as DataDog.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - Legal authorization to work in the United States

 - Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

 - Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

 - May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract

postings.title: Technical Product Manager (Cloud)
postings.description:
ABOUT FOCUS

Focus is a fully remote digital services company dedicated to building highly impactful government digital services. We partner with states and federal agencies, including the Department of State, IRS, and the Department of Education, to design and deliver modern, accessible, and secure software for government programs that impact millions of lives. We bring together engineers, designers, and product thinkers who care deeply about usability, reliability, and creating real impact for our clients and the people they serve.

Our Product Team Lives by:

 - High agency and ownership: you make things happen.

 - Strategic thinking: you see the system, not just the feature.

 - Empathy for users, teammates, and stakeholders alike.

 - Crisp decision-making: you simplify ambiguity into forward motion.


THE ROLE

We're looking for a Technical Product Manager (Cloud) to lead product strategy and delivery for our work with the U.S. Department of Education's Office of Federal Student Aid (FSA), which delivers federal student aid to millions of students and families every year. Our team builds automated testing suites, test data tooling, and CI/CD pipelines in AWS that help multiple vendor teams ship safer releases, faster.

This role sits at the intersection of product management, cloud engineering, and quality. You'll work with engineers, FSA product owners, and third-party vendor teams to define the roadmap, prioritize the backlog, and make sure every release moves the program forward.

The best fit for this role started out technical. Maybe you were a software engineer, or you worked in infrastructure, test automation, QA engineering, or DevOps before moving into product. You can follow an architecture discussion, push back on an estimate, and still translate it all into plain language for agency leadership.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


PRODUCT STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Define and maintain a clear product roadmap aligned to FSA's mission, milestones, and contract objectives using the Focus Delivery Framework

 - Apply structured prioritization frameworks to balance user needs, compliance requirements, and technical feasibility

 - Turn vendor team pain points, release data, and stakeholder goals into epics, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria

 - Define success measures for test coverage, release velocity, defect escape rate, and pipeline reliability


CLOUD & TECHNICAL DELIVERY

 - Partner with engineering leads on AWS architecture, CI/CD pipelines, test automation strategy, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code, and make informed tradeoffs without prescribing implementation

 - Own the backlog for developer self-service tools (test data generation, pipeline status, environment readiness) used by vendor teams and government stakeholders

 - Collaborate with the Technical Lead on DevSecOps and ATO readiness activities so security and compliance are planned in from the start

 - Coordinate technical dependencies across engineering, external vendors, and FSA platform owners


AGILE DELIVERY & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

 - Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives to keep cross-functional teams aligned and unblocked

 - Partner with FSA product owners to balance competing priorities across a multi-vendor federal ecosystem

 - Build alignment across program, policy, and technology partners without formal authority

 - Run demos and sprint reviews that keep stakeholders informed and promote continuous learning


METRICS STRATEGY & DOCUMENTATION

 - Establish a metrics strategy including leading indicators, counterweight metrics, and performance dashboards

 - Create a single source of truth linking technical specifications, user requirements, and decisions

 - Prepare Monthly Project Status Reports and represent delivery health to FSA leadership


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 4-year degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent

 - 5+ years of experience in technical product management, software engineering, or a closely related technical role

 - Prior experience working as an engineer, or working on infrastructure or cloud environments and projects (for example, test automation, QA engineering, or DevOps)

 - Experience on government modernization projects

 - Hands-on cloud experience, AWS preferred (Azure also welcome)

 - Working knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code, enough to clarify edge cases and challenge estimates

 - Strong skills in MVP definition, roadmap creation, and cross-functional delivery using agile methodologies

 - Exceptional executive communication, with the ability to synthesize technical details into clear, scannable updates for leadership

 - Data-driven decision-making; comfortable establishing metrics strategies and analytics frameworks


DESIRED SKILLS

 - Experience with the Department of Education / FSA or other high-volume public services

 - Familiarity with government security requirements (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, ATO processes, Section 508) and Public Trust environments

 - Experience with AWS GovCloud, Terraform, Playwright or similar test frameworks, and observability tooling such as DataDog

 - Experience managing dependencies across multiple vendor teams

 - Comfort with SQL or Python for your own analysis


EMPLOYMENT TYPE & COMPENSATION

We're open to hiring this role as either a W-2 employee or a 1099 contractor. The salary range for this role is $135,000–$175,000.


LOCATION

Remote. All team members must be based in the continental U.S. Some projects may require occasional travel, approximately 1–2 times per year.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Legal authorization to work in the United States

 - Work authorization that doesn't require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

 - Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

 - May be subject to a government background check or security clearance, depending on the contract


WHY FOCUS

We're a growing team of engineers, designers, and product leaders who believe government services can be modern, human-centered, and delightful to use. We value autonomy, transparency, and curiosity — and we're looking for people who want to build products that matter.
